name: Sticky Nav Bar
description: Top navigation with logo, year dropdown, links, social icons, a nav CTA button, and a mobile hamburger.

name: Split Hero
description: Two-column homepage hero: status pill, headline, feature list, CTAs on the left; badges + a this-month card panel on the right; glow video behind.

name: Page Hero
description: Eyebrow + headline + lead paragraph over a star-field. The standard top of every interior page.

name: Status Pill
description: "Shipping now" label with a pulsing green Loader. Signals a live state.

name: A Card, Being Written
description: Card with an accent bar, a typewriter line writing a sample intention, and a copy button.

name: How It Works
description: Bordered container with corner accents, an embedded demo video, and a 3-up numbered steps grid.

name: Comparison Table
description: Feature-by-feature table contrasting the deck with alternatives, using check / cross / warn icons.

name: Deck at a Glance Grid
description: Icon + stat + caption cards laid out on a hairline grid.

name: Ways-to-Use Tabs
description: Tabbed panels that swap content in place to show different scenarios.

name: About the Deck Panel
description: Two-column block: prose on the left, a stacked key/value badge column of deck facts on the right.

name: Principle / Feature Grid
description: Numbered cards (01–06) on a hairline grid describing values or features.

name: Guide Layout
description: Three-column guide shell: collapsible grouped sidebar, centered reading column, right "on this page" TOC.

name: Right TOC (scroll-spy)
description: "On this page" rail that highlights the active heading as you scroll.

name: Monthly Card Grid
description: Catalog of the monthly cards, each with a month name, a highlight badge, and a landmark line.

name: Blog Listing
description: A featured post + side cards, a category filter with search, and a dash-separated post list.

name: Article Layout
description: Article header with cover image and author, a sticky table of contents, and a prose body with pull quotes, callouts, and written-card excerpts.

name: FAQ Accordion
description: Questions grouped by category, each a native disclosure with an animated +/− marker.

name: Landmark Showcase Grid
description: Cards with a gradient placeholder thumbnail, tags, name, description, and a visit link.

name: Year in Moons Timeline
description: Vertical timeline of the year's full moons, with moon dots and a season tag per entry.

name: Moon Calendar Columns
description: Season-grouped columns (Summer, Autumn, Winter, Spring) of month cards with season pills.

name: Support Channels
description: Grid of channel cards plus a numbered "before you email" checklist and quick links.

name: Contact Form
description: Demo form (no backend) beside a column of contact-method cards.

name: Final CTA Block
description: Centered eyebrow + headline + button pair over a star-field, closing a page.

name: Footer
description: Five-column footer with newsletter signup and a bottom bar showing the next full moon date.
